newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar trends higher, spot May leads.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar trends higher, spot May leads.

text.p: CSCE world sugar moved higher toward midsession, fueled by speculative buying of the May-July spread, traders said.
After a slow start to the trading day, the momentum picked up substantially in late morning in a round of pre-weekend short-covering.
The May-July switch, which had been the focus of some heavy selling earlier in the week, was once again in the spotlight, widening to around 0.14 cent, from 0.08 at the close yesterday.
Steady trade buying in the 10.75-10.80 area over the last two sessions gave the market a solid underpinning, dealers said, though commercial operators stayed mainly to the sidelines today.
"We seem to have hit a short-term bottom above 10.70," one broker said.
At 1115 EST, most-active July sugar was 0.07 cent higher, at 10.95 EST. Spot May was 0.11 firmer, to 11.07 cent, while the outer months were 0.01 to 0.03 higher.
To extend the rally, July futures would need clear a near-term objective at 11.01 cents, traders said.
Turnover was heavy, reaching an estimated 17,843 lots as of 1100 EST.
((-- W Pollack, New York Commodities Desk +1 212 859 1640))
